jobs.occupation: Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D (Leiter/in - Softwareentwicklung)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building high-performing engineering organizations and shaping the future of digital product delivery? Do you enjoy combining strong technical understanding with people leadership, operational excellence, and transformation? 

In KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA Einbeck, we are looking for a  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D to lead and further develop our digital engineering organization. As part of the R&D Digital Product & Technology Development leadership team you will drive the delivery of digital products, platforms, and services for R&D, while continuously improving engineering standards, delivery performance, quality, reliability, and productivity.  

You will play a key role in evolving our engineering setup into a more flexible, AI-enabled, and metric-driven organization that can respond dynamically to changing business priorities and accelerate innovation across KWS. 

Your Responsibilities 

As  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D, you will shape the future of digital product delivery at KWS by building a high-performing and adaptable engineering organization that enables innovation on a scale. 

You will: 

- Lead and further develop the engineering organization responsible for delivering digital products, platforms, and services that support our global R&D activities.
- Drive engineering excellence by creating an environment where teams can deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality solutions with speed and impact.
- Build a future-ready organization by advancing modern ways of working, strengthening engineering capabilities, and unlocking the potential of AI across the development lifecycle.
- Foster strong partnerships across business and technology functions while ensuring effective collaboration with external vendors and service partners.
- Inspire, coach, and empower leaders and teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion. 

Your Profile 

You are an experienced technology leader (m/f/d) who enjoys developing people, shaping organizations, and turning ambitious ideas into business value. 

You bring: 

- Proven leadership experience in software engineering, digital product development, or technology-driven organizations.
- A track record successfully leading complex products, platforms, or transformation initiatives in dynamic environments.
- Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and the ability to translate strategic goals into effective execution.
- Experience driving organizational change and building high-performing teams through trust, empowerment, and collaboration.
- Curiosity for emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuously improving how engineering teams work and deliver value.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English. German is a plus. 

What You Can Expect 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape a strategically important engineering function at the interface of digital technology, R&D, and innovation. You will work in a global environment and contribute to strengthening the digital capabilities that support KWS’ future growth. 

You can expect: 

- A leadership role with global scope and high strategic relevance.  
- The opportunity to shape modern engineering standards, practices, and operating models  
- Highly motivated internal teams of software developers working in synthony with external teams
- A strong support to enable new technologies, like AI, and to develop future-ready digital capabilities
- Close collaboration with digital products, technology, R&D, and business stakeholders
- A working environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation 

Join Us 

If you are excited about leading engineering transformation, enabling high-performing teams, and shaping the future of digital product delivery in an innovative R&D environment, we look forward to receiving your application. 

**Grow your career with KWS and help us build the digital capabilities of tomorrow.**

Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!

- Raise the technical output of the team through direction, design review, and pairing.
- Build AI leverage: agentic workflows with the evals and guardrails needed to ship reliably.
- Represent us technically with customers, including workshops and due diligence with bank architects, CISOs, and risk teams, in German and English.
- Partner with senior management and your manager on strategy and prioritisation.

Requirements

- A deeply experienced, hands-on technologist, typically with 8+ years building production software, able to own systems design and still ship code others learn from.
- Fluent in German and English, both essential for our engagement with German banks.
- Large-enterprise context: you have delivered systems inside a large corporate or for a vendor supplying one, and understand how enterprise architecture reviews, security assessments, and change control work.
- Excellent systems design skills, covering distributed systems, services, contracts, data, and integrations.
- AI-forward: you already use coding agents and AI-assisted building in your own work or personal projects.
- A track record of raising the engineers around you through influence, design review, and example.
- Senior-management maturity: you translate technical risk into terms the business can act on.
- Credible and calm when bank architects and risk functions question design choices.
- Security-minded: secure-by-design thinking, OAuth/OIDC, and data protection appropriate to banking.
- Rigorous about quality: you design for verifiability and verify rather than assume.
- Regulated-industry experience, with banking or FinTech a major bonus.
- Cloud experience: GCP preferred, with AWS or Azure also welcome, plus familiarity with IaC, containers, and CI/CD.
- Nice to have: Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, the GCP stack, privacy-enhancing technology or applied cryptography (MPC especially), multi-tenant SaaS, and the anti-financial-crime domain.

Flat structures that let the team move quickly.

heyport is an innovative startup from the Port of Hamburg, transforming the maritime industry with a state-of-the-art digital planning platform. Their mission is to promote smart and sustainable port operations through real-time collaboration and communication. As a scalable solution for ports worldwide, heyport supports terminals, vessel operators, and port communities by providing reliable planning information and ensuring everyone is aligned. With port call coordination in the DNA, heyport has facilitated over 10,000 port calls on their platform, demonstrating its versatility across container, ro-ro, and bulk terminals. The users benefit from significant efficiency gains, including a 14% reduction in CO2 emissions through just-in-time arrivals, a 90% decrease in manual communication, and an average of 180 minutes saved on planning - per port call.

Sales & Business Development Manager (m/f/d)

Hamburg / remote

Hamburg, St. Annenufer 2

heyport GmbH

You want a job that shapes the future of the maritime industry — and you’re the kind of person who actually enjoys the full ride from cold outreach to signed contract? Then read on.

heyport is not your average startup. We’re building the digital platform for just-in-time port call and berth planning — simplifying coordination between terminals, vessel operators, and all port stakeholders in real time. Our SaaS platform is live, growing, and operating across Container, Ro-Ro, and Bulk terminals worldwide.

As a Sales & Business Development Manager (m/f/d), you take full ownership of customer relationships and actively shape how we sell. Working closely with our founders and product colleagues, you turn market feedback into commercial traction and help build the foundation for how we scale as a team.

Now we’re looking for someone who is hungry to sell, loves the craft of it, and wants to grow with us.

What you can expect

- Own the Full Cycle - 360°: You run the whole show - from identifying and qualifying leads, booking your own meetings, running product demos, to negotiating and closing the deal.
- Build the Machine: Help us establish and sharpen our sales processes, playbooks, and tools. You’ll have real input into how we scale - not just execute someone else’s script.
- Identify Opportunities: Proactively reach out to potential customers and partners across the maritime ecosystem - terminals, vessel operators, agents, port authorities - and make them genuinely excited about heyport.
- Negotiate with Confidence: Handle pricing conversations and contract agreements with clarity and a sense for what’s fair for both sides.
- Show Up & Show Expertise: Represent heyport at national and international maritime events, conferences, and trade forums and build strong, trusted industry network.
- Stay Process-Sharp: Maintain clean CRM hygiene, structured pipeline management, and a continuous drive to improve how we sell - tools, sequences, qualification frameworks, all of it.
- Collaborate for Success: Work closely with our founders, product, and customer success colleagues. Your feedback from the field directly shapes the product and messaging.

What you bring to the table

- Experience in B2B sales or business development, with real exposure to a full sales cycle - ideally in a maritime, logistics, or SaaS environment.
- A genuine passion for sales as a craft - you enjoy prospecting, demos, objection handling, and closing, and you’re motivated to continuously improve how you sell.
- Confidence working across multiple outreach channels (e.g. email, LinkedIn, IM, and the phone). Cold calling doesn't scare you.
- Hands-on experience with CRM systems, outreach tooling, sales sequences, and pipeline management.
- Fluent English is a must. Additional languages (e.g. Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic) are a real asset in our international sales environment.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, paired with the ability to listen, ask the right questions, and adapt to different counterparts
- Entrepreneurial, ownership-driven mindset - you’re comfortable building processes as you go, working with incomplete structures, and traveling internationally (a reasonable amount - we don’t live in airports).

Are you interested, but don't meet all the requirements? Let's talk!

What we offer you

- Real ownership: You will take on full responsibility for your role and outcomes. Your pipeline, your deals, your growth.
- Room to grow fast: As heyport scales, your responsibility, and development opportunities grow with it.
- Competitive compensation package, including performance-based incentives: 60.000€ - 75.000€
- Flexibility for a healthy work-life balance: Mobile working and trust-based working hours - we care about output, not attendance.
- A central workplace in Hamburg’s Speicherstadt: One of the best office locations in Germany, right between HafenCity and the city centre (and yes, the coffee is good).
- A small, focused team: We work closely together, taking our work seriously, but not ourselves too much.

About Infront

At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. 

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. 

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially focused Pre-Sales Specialist to support the growth of our Infront Quant Valuation & Risk offering (IQ Risk) and our independent Valuation Services across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Luxembourg.

Working as a trusted advisor alongside regional Sales Executives, you will engage with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle, demonstrating how our multi-asset risk analytics and independent valuation services address the complex needs of banks, asset managers, insurers, pension funds, fund administrators, AIFMs, family offices and institutional investors.

This is a quota-carrying role with co-prime responsibility for the achievement of sales targets for the in-scope Valuation & Risk product suite. Success requires a combination of strong business acumen, quantitative and financial markets expertise, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to articulate business value to both executive and operational stakeholders.

This position is based in Frankfurt am Main, where you will work closely with our quant analysts, model developers, and valuation service specialists, gaining direct access to the expertise behind IQ Risk and our independent valuation offerings.

As our Pre-Sales Specialist, you will:

- Partner with Regional Sales Executives to develop account strategies, drive revenue growth, and support commercial negotiations across assigned territories.
- Qualify client business, functional, quantitative, and technical requirements, contributing to opportunity planning, competitive positioning, and solution design.
- Deliver demonstrations, proof of concepts, valuation benchmarks, solution proposals, and technical validation activities tailored to client needs.
- Lead discovery workshops to understand valuation policies, risk measurement processes, market data requirements, and regulatory obligations.
- Design and present solution architectures, including API, data feed, and file-based integrations, that align client requirements with product capabilities.
- Act as a subject matter expert for valuation methodologies, risk analytics, and relevant regulatory frameworks, while positioning Infront Quant's independent approach against alternative solutions.
- Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across investments, risk, valuation, operations, compliance, fund accounting, and technology functions, articulating the business value and ROI of our solutions to audiences ranging from end users to executive leadership.
- Collaborate closely with Quant Analytics, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, sharing market and regulatory insights to support product development, competitive positioning, and sales success.
- Travel regularly across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Luxembourg to support client meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal collaboration.

Who you are

- Proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Engineering supporting enterprise SaaS, financial technology, or quantitative analytics solutions.
- Strong understanding of valuation, risk analytics, capital markets, and financial instruments, ideally across fixed income, derivatives, and structured products.
- Experience supporting complex, consultative B2B sales cycles and engaging with senior business and technical stakeholders.
- Excellent presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational challenges into effective technology and service solutions.
- Commercially minded with experience working toward revenue targets or shared sales objectives.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both business and technical audiences.
- Self-motivated and comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
- Knowledge of valuation and risk management solutions, market data vendors, APIs, cloud technologies, quantitative risk concepts, and RFP/RFI processes is advantageous.
- Fluent German and English are essential; additional European language skills are considered a strong advantage.
- A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, as well as professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CAIA, or equivalent, are considered a strong advantage.

Our Offer

**Health & wellness:** Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.

**Holiday:** Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.

**Pension:** Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions.

**Remote work:** Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.

**Learning & development:** Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.

**Culture & impact:** Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.

**Our offices:** Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.

Additional notes

*Note: Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

All candidates selected for employment are subject to pre-employment screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the world's leading logistics service providers, operating on a global scale. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.

What you can expect

- As the operational lead for Life Science & Healthcare in Germany, you ensure compliance with all applicable GDP, GxP, quality, and regulatory requirements while maintaining effective governance frameworks.
- Beyond ensuring compliance, you continuously enhance quality standards and operational processes to support excellence across the organization.
- In close collaboration with internal, customer, and regulatory stakeholders, you coordinate audits, certification activities, and the implementation of improvement measures.
- A strong focus of the role is the oversight of CAPA processes, ensuring findings are addressed effectively and sustainably.
- By establishing transparent reporting and governance mechanisms, you monitor key quality, compliance, and operational KPIs and provide clear performance insights.
- Together with your team, you create an environment that promotes quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What you bring

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Life Sciences, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
- Significant experience in Life Science & Healthcare logistics, supply chain management, contract logistics, or a similar regulated environment.
- Proven success in operational leadership roles, combined with a strong understanding of GDP, GxP, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
- Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives, drive organizational change, and deliver sustainable business improvements.
- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, paired with fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.

Your benefits

- Agile Environment: Embrace a dynamic work culture, where you and your team adapt quickly to meet evolving needs.
- Events: From team outings to holiday parties and networking events, we build strong connections by spending quality time together.
- Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy exclusive perks: Our extensive partner network gives you access to special discounts with various providers.
- Flexible Working Hours: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.
- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.
- Personalized Growth: Accelerate your career with development opportunities, tailored to your talents and interests.

FFT Produktionssysteme GmbH & Co. KG ist ein weltweit agierender Systemanbieter von automatisierten und flexiblen Fertigungseinrichtungen.
Ihre Aufgaben bei Fosun FFT Holding

The job advertisement is for a position at Fosun FFT Holding.

- Consolidated Financial Statement Preparation: Review European subsidiaries' standalone accounts and prepare monthly/quarterly/yearly group consolidation statements with full elimination entries for intercompany balances, equity transactions and inventory unrealized profits. Support IPO initiatives through financial remediation, historical restatements and submission of audit-ready consolidation data.
- Financial Analysis & Reporting Deliver regional performance, budget variance and P&L analysis based on consolidated and local financial data, delivering actionable insights for overseas operations and strategic decisions.
- Stakeholder Liaison Communicate with German local auditors, tax advisors, banks and authorities, while coordinating with Group Finance to align cross-border accounting data and resolve financial discrepancies efficiently
- Documentation & Consolidation Framework Maintain complete archives of vouchers, financial statements, tax and audit records. and fully support internal/external audits and IPO due diligence

Was Sie auszeichnet

- Skilled in consolidated statements for overseas companies, including intercompany elimination, foreign currency conversion and equity offset; able to adjust accounts under IFRS and Chinese accounting standards
- Experienced in IPO and capital finance projects. Can coordinate with auditors and securities firms, fix historical accounting issues and make complete consolidation files.Strong in data analysis and report writing, logical sorting and financial documentation drafting
- Language: Business English, Business German（B2 above)
- Degree: Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Financial Management, Auditing or related disciplines. Holders of CPA, ACCA or local German accounting certifications are preferred
- Professional Experience: Minimum 5 years of finance experience, including at least 3 years of consolidated financial statement preparation
- Technical Skills: Familiar with German local tax and accounting regulations; adept at mainstream financial systems such as SAP and consolidation software

As a Supply Chain Quality Manager (d/m/w), you take responsibility for supply chain and quality topics within the Customer Service area in Hamburg Finkenwerder. - Manage supplier quality and supply chain performance, ensuring on-time and on-quality delivery.
- Identify supplier risks and drive recovery, improvement, and mitigation plans.
- Support supplier selection and assessment during tender processes.
- Monitor New Product Introduction (NPI) and Transfer of Work (ToW) activities.
- Ensure supplier compliance with Airbus and EASA requirements.
- Support After Sales ramp-up activities and continuous supplier development.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Quality, or a related field.
- 3 years of experience in Supply Chain, Supplier Management, Procurement, Quality Management, or Quality Assurance.
- Strong knowledge of SAP R/3 and project management methodologies.
- Fluent in English.
- Experience in supplier recovery plans, After Sales, or the Airbus environment is an advantage.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 78.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

As a Flightline Technical Planner (d/m/w) at Airbus, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless preparation and coordination of aircraft materials and processes in the Flightline and Delivery phase. Located in Hamburg Finkenwerder, this full-time position (35h) involves a dynamic mix of technical planning, project participation, and problem-solving. Working closely with various stakeholders internally and externally, you will translate design documents into manufacturing tasks while monitoring real-time disruptions and initiating suitable measures. You will also manage material procurement, ensure adherence to technical solutions, and oversee the administrative and operational aspects of aircraft delivery to customers.

Key responsibilities include:

- Supporting aircraft operations post FOT (Fall Operation Test) at the Flightline and preparing deliveries to customers.
- Managing material procurement, delivery, and monitoring order processes.
- Recording maintenance issues and defining technical solutions.
- Identifying disruptions in real-time and coordinating corrective actions involving required departments.
- Providing technical and administrative support during the Flightline and Delivery phases.
- Planning and coordinating tasks with partners, suppliers, and external firms.
- Implementing design documents into manufacturing orders while considering technical instructions.
- Participating in projects and leading sub-projects as needed.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Technical education or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 2 years of experience in aircraft manufacturing and 1 year in production or manufacturing engineering.
- Aerospace experience and familiarity with Flightline/Delivery operations are critical.
- Advanced knowledge of IT tools such as SAP, zamiz, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, and Google Workspace.
- Proficiency in German and English at a negotiation level.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
